current.text: He is projected to come off the bench. The projected starters are White, Knueppel, Miller, Reid and Diabaté, with Grayson Allen starting while Knueppel is out.
Experts expect Charlotte not to start him. He should not take Coby White's starting spot unless White gets hurt.
Coby White is out with a calf injury and will probably miss the start of the season. Kon Knueppel is also hurt.
Do not take him inside the top 200. His Yahoo ADP of 128 is too high. One expert would take him only with the last pick of a draft.
Charlotte has a deep roster, so bench minutes are spread across many players.
Charlotte plays 4, 3 and 4 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21. It has only 13 back-to-backs, the league minimum.
